meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:
India mein women ke liye **kurta sets** kharidne ke liye aap in brands ko consider kar sakte hain, depending on aapka budget aur style preference: **Libas**, **Biba**, **Aurelia**, **W for Woman**, **Varanga**, **Aachho**, **Jaipur Kurti**, **Indya**, **Jaypore**, aur **Ensemble**.[1][2][6][8][9][11][13][18][19]

Agar aap **everyday wear** chahte hain to **Libas**, **Aurelia**, **Biba**, **W for Woman**, aur **Jaipur Kurti** achhe options hain, kyunki inki collections mein straight, cotton, printed, aur regular-use kurta sets milte hain.[1][2][6][8][13][16]

Agar aapko **festive ya occasion wear** chahiye to **Aachho**, **Indya**, **Jaypore**, aur **Ensemble** zyada suitable hain, kyunki in brands mein embroidered, designer, aur craft-focused kurta sets milte hain.[9][11][18][19]

Agar aap **budget-friendly** options dekh rahe hain to **Meesho** aur **Trendia** par bhi kaafi variety mil jaati hai, lekin quality aur consistency brand-to-brand aur seller-to-seller vary kar sakti hai.[5][15]

Quick pick guide:
- **Budget + variety:** Meesho, Trendia[5][15]
- **Daily cotton wear:** Libas, Aurelia, Biba, Jaipur Kurti[1][6][8][13]
- **Office / smart ethnic:** W for Woman, Varanga, Indya[2][3][18]
- **Festive / premium:** Aachho, Jaypore, Ensemble[9][11][19]

Agar aap chahein, main aapke **budget** ke hisaab se 5 best kurta-set brands shortlist kar doon—jaise **₹1500 ke andar**, **₹3000 ke andar**, ya **festive wear**.
